notes.title: Bullet Runner: The Prologue Is Out Now
notes.content:
[h1]If you know what The BFG is, then this game is made for you
[/h1]
[i]Bullet Runner is Doom-esque top-down shooter coming in late 2023 but releasing a 4-hour free prologue version out already in November 2022. Load your BFG and get in the game![/i]

Bullet Runner is like pure adrenaline poured into your brain and veins, just like the good ol’ days with Doom and Quake. You are Jack, and for some reason everyone wants you dead. Buller Runner is a top-down shooter where you run your way through the enemy-filled facility shooting, blasting, and raging through any obstacle set in your way.

[i]“My love for DOOM Eternal is very strong, and I wanted to create my own kind of homage to the Doom series. Fighting and especially the glory kill mechanisms will be familiar for all like minded players, but in Bullet Runner the main character is just a regular badass-Jack''[/i] tells Laura Moon, the developer behind the game.

[previewyoutube=GXS0Vzm3XcQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is set to be released in late 2023 with well over 10 hours of gameplay, but the developer prepared a special free prologue to be released already in November 2022. The prologue will feature a lot of game to play – it will take about 3—4 hours for an average player to slay through the game. It is clear this prologue is not a demo, but a full game with specifically designed levels.

[h2]Main features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Action-packed top-down shooter with free 4-hour prologue out in November 2022
[*] Lots of guns and items, glory-kills, missions to solve, enemies to slay, and smooth movement extras like rail slides, running on barrels, and chain swings
[*] Prologue out until the 31st of December, with updated and new features hinted during the period
[/list]
 
Bullet Runner on Steam (Prologue opening on Tue, November 22nd 2022 as a Steam Playtest): [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/771870/Bullet_Runner/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/771870/Bullet_Runner/[/url]
